purpose: Enumeration of every Observation code present in the three demo cohorts, with display names, units and observed value extrema. This is the evidence base for manifests/rules/loinc_ranges.yaml; every bound in that file is checked against the extrema recorded here by tests/test_ranges.py.
caveats: eICU codes 1, 2, 3, 4 and 7 are eICU labtypeid integers, not LOINC codes. A single code aggregates many unrelated analytes, so range rules for these codes must be scoped by unit; see the by_unit breakdown.
MIMIC-IV codes (50802, 51221, ...) are MIMIC d_labitems itemids, not LOINC codes.
Both cohorts nevertheless declare system=http://loinc.org, so the code string is used verbatim as the rule key.
Only Synthea carries category=vital-signs, social-history, survey and exam; MIMIC-IV and eICU Observations are effectively all category=laboratory.
